title: Conditional finite-p propagation with an independently controlled mixed staircase norm

conditional_staircase.electric_bound: |integral E dot j_n| <= C_p |e| ||E||_p M_(n,p) E_n^(1/2)
conditional_staircase.energy_inequality: dE_n/dt <= C_p |e| ||E||_p M_(n,p) E_n^(1/2)+C_p ||partial_t f||_p E_n
conditional_staircase.square_root_form: d sqrt(E_n)/dt <= C_p |e| ||E||_p M_(n,p)+C_p ||partial_t f||_p sqrt(E_n) wherever E_n>0
conditional_staircase.integrability: propagation holds on intervals where ||E||_p M_(n,p) and ||partial_t f||_p are time-integrable
conditional_staircase.boundary: the estimate assumes rather than derives M_(n,p), does not conserve an augmented hierarchy and does not prove global existence
